content:
lin: quick idea dump: instead of mutating saved queries we surface a candidate binding list when a user opens a view. ui shows the best match but lets you pick another. keeps savedviews immutable.

ana: +1. immutability reduces surprising side-effects. how do we compute "best match"? should model affinity trump route specificity?

sam: propose deterministic scoring: exact (route+model) > route-only > model-only > global. within same score, prefer newest binding. keeps behavior predictable.

maria: two concerns: 1) perf of resolving candidates for thousands of routes, 2) auditability. both matter for enterprise tenants.

tyler: perf: precompute binding index scoped per org; cache top N candidates per view. invalidation on binding write. audit: every binding change should emit an event to audit-log service with actor and reason.

kevin: authz: who can create bindings? route owners only seems safe but product owners want the ability to bind cross-route dashboards. maybe allow 'bindable' role scoped to teams.

lin: agreed on role gating. UI should hide the binding action if you lack permissions and provide a request button that populates a prefilled ticket to ops.

ana: migration path: many savedviews are global. we should offer a bulk candidate scan job that suggests bindings (heuristics: top routes calling the underlying query, model usage in last 30d). then we can show a list for owners to accept.

sam: nice. for the API: GET /v2/console/views/:id/candidates -> [{binding_id, route_id?, model_id?, score, reason_hint}]. POST /v2/console/views/:id/bindings to create. DELETE /v2/console/views/:id/bindings/:id to remove. keep payload small.

maria: let's standardize reason_hint strings for UI: "exact-match", "route-usage-based-suggest", "manual-created". helps tooltips.

tyler: telemetry: when a bound view is applied we should emit view_applied event with fields: view_id, binding_id? (if applied), resolved_route, resolved_model, suggested_sample. make suggested_sample advisory only.

kevin: on data model: option A - normalized table view_bindings(view_id, route_id nullable, model_id nullable, sample_hint, created_by, created_at). Option B - jsonb array on views row. A is easier to index for candidates. prefer A.

lin: for rollout: feature flag the candidates endpoint and UI toggle. canary to internal orgs + a small group of customers. track two metrics: % of savedview opens where resolved binding differs from user expectation (via quick survey) and variance between quota_preview_estimate and actual usage.

ana: small ui detail: show a subtle banner when fallback to global occurs: "This view has no route binding. Quota previews may be approximate." with an inline "bind" CTA.

sam: edgecases: model families (e.g., llama-70b-8bit variants). should bindings allow wildcard model_id patterns or link to model_family attribute?

maria: allow optional model_family field on binding and let resolution match family when exact model fails. but require explicit admin approval for wildcard-type semantics.

tyler: i'll draft the event contract and add hinted_sample plumbing; sam/jordan can do the candidate API. lin/kevin can own migration tooling.

ops-bot: scheduled feature-flag rollout for "view-candidates" to internal orgs on 2026-03-24T04:00:00Z.
